_about: Tool map for the Claude in Chrome extension (built into Claude Code, server name claude-in-chrome), used by the write gate. Any tool on this server that is not listed is denied. Tool names checked in a Claude Code session on 2026-11-26.

ask_reasons.javascript_tool: runs your own JavaScript inside the app page
ask_reasons.file_upload: sends a file from this computer to the app
ask_reasons.upload_image: sends an image from this computer to the app
ask_reasons.browser_batch: runs several browser actions in one call, so check the whole list
ask_reasons.select_browser: switches to another Chrome browser or profile (stay on the test profile)
ask_reasons.switch_browser: switches to another Chrome browser or profile (stay on the test profile)
ask_reasons.gif_creator: records the screen into a file, which may show personal data

tested_with: Claude in Chrome extension tool names as of 2026-11-26
